failure_summary.description: Returned an expanded party nickname or full title when the clue called for only the distinctive completion.
Echoed a proverb fragment instead of inferring the omitted subject or headword.
Treated a trivia category label for the following clue as the answer to the preceding clue.

patch.reasoning: Clarify how to answer cloze-style title and nickname clues, extend implicit-completion guidance to familiar proverbs, and disambiguate labels that appear between adjacent trivia clues.

edits.target: For fragmentary quotes or titles, prefer a direct completion supported by context over a merely related result.
edits.content: For fragmentary quotes, titles, nicknames, or familiar sayings and proverbs, infer the omitted word or phrase that completes the clue rather than echoing the supplied text. Return only the identifying portion requested: do not repeat title wording already supplied by the clue or append a generic class word when it is implicit, unless the full name is requested or needed to distinguish the answer.

edits.target: In trivia-style passages, headings or labels before a colon may be categories rather than answers; solve the clue itself.
edits.content: In trivia-style lists, a heading or label before a colon may be the category for the clue that follows, including when it appears immediately after the previous clue. Do not assign such a label to the preceding clue; solve the requested clue from its meaning and corroborating context.
